title: Opening: interview at Francis's home and birth date question
summary: Russell announces the interview at Albert Francis's New Orleans home and asks his name and birth date.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I'll make a note to start here that we're interviewing Mr. Albert Francis at his home at 1922. Mandeville, yeah. Mandeville Street downtown New Orleans and this is Bill Russell. You made this book? I've read most of that. I thought you didn't know about Russell? No, no, that's Sam Charter's book. He's supposed to view some of the notes that Dick Allen took. Maybe if Dick ever talked to you, you might have some notes from him too in there. Do you mind giving your full name, your middle name and all? Albert F. Francis, yeah. F. Francis. And do you mind telling just when you were born and what part of town? Is it here in New Orleans? Can you give us your birth date?
